title: Raku Party
source_quote: You then can come in and glaze it using our special Raku glazes then experience the entire firing process as we fire your pieces in the Raku kiln.
evidence_sentence: Groups can glaze pre-made raku pieces and experience the entire firing process in the studio's raku kiln.
evidence_quote: experience the entire firing process as we fire your pieces in the Raku kiln
summary: Public raku firing parties for groups of 6 or more; participants glaze pre-made pieces and watch the firing. Contact the studio to schedule.
